name: Augmedix
description: Augmedix is a medical documentation company acquired by Commure in 2024. They offer both AI-powered ambient documentation (Augmedix Go) and hybrid human+AI scribing services. The platform captures patient conversations and generates clinical notes, with options for human quality assurance review for organizations requiring additional accuracy guarantees.

pricing.estimated_range: $150-400 per provider per month (varies by service level)

free_trial.notes: Pilot programs available for health systems

pricing.notes: Pricing varies significantly based on AI-only vs hybrid human+AI model. Enterprise contracts typical.

ambient_ai.description: Augmedix Go provides fully automated ambient documentation

hybrid_model.description: Augmedix Live combines AI with human scribe review for maximum accuracy

best_for: Health systems wanting hybrid human+AI option
Practices using Epic, Cerner, or Athenahealth
Practices that tried AI-only and want human oversight
not_for: Organizations wanting AI-only without human review costs

seo.meta_description: Augmedix review - hybrid AI + human scribe documentation by Commure. 98%+ accuracy with human QA. Epic/Cerner integration. Enterprise pricing for health systems.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Augmedix Go and Augmedix Live?
faqs.answer: Augmedix Go is their fully AI-powered ambient documentation service. Augmedix Live combines AI with human medical scribes who review and refine the notes, providing 98%+ accuracy for organizations requiring maximum documentation quality.

faqs.question: How much does Augmedix cost?
faqs.answer: Augmedix requires a custom quote with pricing typically ranging from $150-400 per provider per month. The AI-only Augmedix Go is less expensive than the hybrid Augmedix Live service that includes human QA.

faqs.question: Is Augmedix part of Commure?
faqs.answer: Yes, Augmedix was acquired by Commure in 2024. The acquisition combined Augmedix's documentation expertise with Commure's healthcare platform capabilities.

faqs.question: Does Augmedix integrate with Epic?
faqs.answer: Yes, Augmedix has native integration with Epic and can write documentation directly into the EHR. It also integrates with Cerner, Athenahealth, MEDITECH, and eClinicalWorks.
